sql_templates.overview: Use SELECT statements to gather information on stocks meeting the criteria of new highs, VCP, or breakouts with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.select_template:
SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name, e.close, p.vcp_score, p.enhanced_fund_score 
FROM market.equity_eod e 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON e.symbol = s.symbol 
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks p ON s.symbol = p.symbol 
WHERE e.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod) 
AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
AND p.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks) 
AND e.series = 'EQ' 
AND s.stage = 'STAGE_2' 
AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY') 
ORDER BY p.vcp_score DESC 
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Fetch FII/DII flows, regime, breadth, and index data for last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_data AS (
    SELECT 
        f.trade_date AS trade_date,
        f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.fii_trend, f.dii_trend,
        r.regime, r.confidence,
        b.ad_signal, b.trin_5d_signal, b.market_sentiment,
        i.trading_signal
    FROM 
        signals.fii_dii_flows f
    JOIN 
        signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
    JOIN 
        breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
    JOIN 
        market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
    WHERE 
        f.trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
    AND 
        i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
    ORDER BY 
        f.trade_date DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM latest_data;

synthesis_guidance: ['Summarize findings in a concise table.', 'Highlight risk-on/off signals based on gathered evidence.']
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 0022
